STAGE: scope-contract check of all four proposals (rank-2026-10-v1).
GOAL: decide which proposals are in scope before ranking, since an out-of-scope proposal must be sent back rather than scored.
READ: the four proposal blocks (nullcurv-hinge-rq, CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ, ORC-CELLCHART, CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ) and their frozen bundles (2ec8dfb2e08a4282, 69fae840a943a6a9, 7d383ca4ae78e044, e07e5e8696f932e4).
OBSERVED: all four name (1) a training-only behaviour signal (directed transitions W_ij / symmetrised co-consumption counts, quotient-contracted), (2) an explicit curved operation (Lorentz d_{L,c} with exp/log maps; Poincare d_k with Mobius addition; Mobius log transport) placed in the quantizer nearest-code rule, (3) one pathway where the geometry changes the assignment (and for nullcurv-hinge also a loss gradient into c_l), (4) the behaviour-off/geometry-off/both-on switches stated as a comparison design with no arm run, (5) equations plus guards.
REASONING: none of the four is a behaviour suffix on an unchanged Euclidean quantizer, and none is a standalone hyperbolic loss beside an unrelated behaviour loss; the geometry enters the assignment metric in every case, so all four pass the scope contract. The ranking therefore turns on evidence grounding and single-run risk, not on admissibility.
OPEN: which of the four is best grounded in the observed evidence (E4-E11) and most likely to clear 0.065 in one run.

STAGE: evidence-grounded comparison against the observed bundle entries (E4-E11), shared by all four bundles.
GOAL: find the observed quantities that actually discriminate the proposals, since E1-E3/E12-E13 are self-descriptions and cannot ground a placement.
READ: E6 width-20 beam survival, E7 teacher-forced per-position NLL, E8 first-level capacity ceiling, E9 cohort-profile signal, E10 transition-graph coverage, E11 baseline prefix-rate diagnostic.
OBSERVED: (i) no arm exceeds 0.06363 (resample); the survivors keep level-1 alive (resample depth-1 0.497 at 0.06363; l1_br_euclid depth-2 0.829 at 0.06207), while l1_br with depth-1 1.000 and depth-4 0.068 scores 0.04671 and has T4 NLL 9.03, i.e. a saturated/degenerate deep level. (ii) The curvature-flavoured arms are the weakest: successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, with T1 NLL 2.53/2.35/4.00 (E7) versus 0.00 for the Euclidean arms, so hyperbolic residual transport damages level-1 discrimination. (iii) E8: share of canonical pairs co-clustered at K=256 is only 0.0822 vs 0.3106 at K=16, so K=256 level-1 is already capacity-starved. (iv) E10: 118,315 edges, 115,582 distinct, mean out-degree 5.4526 over 24,556 items, so the transition graph is very sparse.
REASONING: the discriminating criterion is (a) whether the mechanism protects level-1 and level-3 code usage, which E6/E7/E8 identify as the dominant driver, (b) whether it perturbs the quantizer minimally, because E6/E7 show the geometry-heavy arms losing to Euclidean ones, and (c) whether per-estimate sample size is adequate, which E10 constrains. Per-level mechanisms (3 curvature parameters) are far better estimated than per-code ones (768 cells over a 5.45-degree graph). CURVALLOC is the only one with explicit mean-zero + clip-bounded + EMA level-1/level-3 usage guards, zero extra loss term, and a radius channel (rho_l) that changes relative code distances so the coupling is not the near-scale-invariant one. nullcurv-hinge has the cleanest constant derivation and full gradient coupling but no usage guard and a curvature surrogate whose influence on the partition is second-order because Ollivier curvature is nearly invariant under the metric rescaling that c_l induces. ORC-CELLCHART's per-code field is the most data-starved under E10 and its own risk list concedes the #127-style early level-1 usage shrink. CURVPROF is squarely in the family that E6/E7 measure as worst.
OPEN: final ordering and the one-line reasons.

STAGE: final placement.
GOAL: fix positions 1..4 with no ties and ground each in the evidence.
READ: records 1-2 above.
OBSERVED: the ordering that follows from E6/E7/E8 usage-dominance plus E10 sparsity is CURVALLOC > nullcurv-hinge > ORC-CELLCHART > CURVPROF.
REASONING: position 1 CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ: explicit level-1 and level-3 usage guards absorb the E6/E7 collapse signature, the mean-zero bounded perturbation keeps the change minimal relative to the E6 finding that geometry-heavy arms lose, and the per-level radius gives a non-scale-invariant assignment channel. Position 2 nullcurv-hinge-rq: strongest coupling and fully derived constants, but no usage guard and a weak differentiable curvature surrogate. Position 3 ORC-CELLCHART: novel per-code channel but data-starved at K=256 under E10 and carries the #127 risk it names. Position 4 CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ: its closest measured precedents (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, T1 NLL 4.00) are the weakest entries in the bundle and the near-identity flat-regime admission leaves it below the 0.062-0.0636 band.
OPEN: none; the answer block follows as the last record.

FINAL ANSWER (rank-2026-10-v1), complete:
RANK: CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ | position=1 | reason=E6 shows no arm clears 0.06363 and the survivors are those that keep level-1 and deep prefixes alive (resample 0.06363 with depth-1 0.497, l1_br_euclid 0.06207 with depth-2 0.829) while E7 shows the collapsed arm at T4 NLL 9.03 and E8 puts the K=256 level-1 ceiling at 0.0822, so the only proposal with explicit mean-zero, clip-bounded level-1/level-3 usage guards and a data-derived per-level radius channel (rho_l) that changes relative code distances is the best single-run bet.
RANK: nullcurv-hinge-rq | position=2 | reason=its per-level Lorentz d_{L,c} inside the nearest-code rule is the tightest behaviour-geometry pathway and every constant is derived (lambda from the step-0 loss ratio, eps = 0.05 * measured mean distance, margin 0), but it carries no usage guard against the E6/E7 collapse signature and E10's very sparse graph (mean out-degree 5.4526) leaves the differentiable curvature surrogate with little partition-level gradient, so its channel is second-order.
RANK: ORC-CELLCHART | position=3 | reason=per-code charts are genuinely new and address E8's one-geometry-for-all-codes problem, but E10's 5.4526 mean out-degree leaves each of 256 cells with almost no quotient mass and its own risk list concedes the early level-1 usage shrink that E6 (l1_br 0.04671) and E7 (T1 NLL 2.53-4.00) mark as the failure mode.
RANK: CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ | position=4 | reason=the closest measured precedents are the weakest arms in the bundle - successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 with near-uniform T1 NLL 4.00 in E6/E7 - and the proposal itself concedes the Mobius transport is near-identity in the flat regime, so it sits below the 0.062-0.0636 Euclidean band it has to beat; m, the z*_l target formation and the K/2 occupancy floor are also the least specified constants.
